metadata.description: Marketplace pessoal: 19 plugins (skills, hooks e automações) para Claude Code.

plugins.name: archify
plugins.description: Create professional architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as explorable standalone HTML files with SVG graphics, dark/light themes, and export to PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM. Accepts plain-language descriptions or pasted Mermaid code.

plugins.name: bootstrap
plugins.description: Bootstrap a new machine to this versioned Claude Code setup — auto-syncs marketplaces and plugins via hooks AND applies the versioned global config (env, permissions, flags, global CLAUDE.md, machine-resolved statusLine). Run /bootstrap:setup once per machine. Replaces bootstrap-third-party.

plugins.name: branches
plugins.description: Diz quais branches dá pra apagar e quais NÃO dá. O `git branch --merged` mente por omissão: squash-merge e rebase produzem sha novo, então a branch aparece como não-mergeada mesmo com o conteúdo inteiro no tronco — e é por isso que a pilha cresce até o deploy reclamar de 15 branches abertas. Classifica por CONTEÚDO (patch-id), mostra o que só existe em cada branch antes de você decidir, e apaga só o que você marcar — sempre com tag de resgate. Mais dois avisos: no push de branch que ainda não entrou no tronco, e no começo da sessão quando há branch parada há mais de um mês.

plugins.name: context-guard
plugins.description: Dispara o handoff quando o contexto DESTA sessão passa do threshold (default 80%). Estado por-sessão (v1.2.0) — uma sessão cheia não bloqueia as concorrentes. v1.3.0: não interrompe se já estiver no meio de um handoff, e faz o Claude EXECUTAR o /handoff (decision:block) em vez de só parar. Kill-switch: ~/.claude/context-guard/mode=off.

plugins.name: fallow
plugins.description: Runs Fallow (static JS/TS analyzer — dead code, duplication, complexity), classifies findings by type and confidence, and delivers an interactive report where you pick what to clean. Audits the Fallow report (convergence goal + liveness propagation) to catch false-positives the static analysis misses — cron/systemd, HTTP routes, dynamic imports — framed as tool limitations, not code bugs. Cleanup with a safety net (preview + build/test).

plugins.name: graphify-guard
plugins.description: Ensures graphify knowledge graphs get consulted when relevant. SessionStart heads-up when a project has a graph; PreToolUse net redirects blind grep/glob/find to `graphify query` once per session. Detects stale graphs and offers `graphify --update`. Defense in depth, fail-open, monorepo-aware.

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Relentless one-question-at-a-time design review. Stress-tests plans and decisions by walking every branch of the decision tree.

plugins.name: grill-with-docs
plugins.description: Relentless design review that challenges plans against the project's domain model, sharpens terminology, and updates CONTEXT.md and ADRs inline as decisions crystallise.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Global editing guardrails as hooks: post-edit lint & type-check (JS/TS/Python), an LLM scope-cop that blocks UI edits drifting from the approved plan, and an Agent Teams misuse guard. Portable across machines — replaces hand-rolled hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json. Run /guardrails:setup once per machine to set the env var and clear the old hooks.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Session continuity in a single command — /handoff detects the session state and routes: full context → saves a complete knowledge-transfer document; freshly cleared session → resumes from it. Workspace-aware: the handoff belongs to the project the session touched (resolves the .git boundary of the edited files), so it works for a standalone project, a monorepo (one HANDOFF-<module>.md per module), or an umbrella folder with nested projects — no more clobbering between parallel sessions on the same root. Optional [salvar|retomar] argument forces the mode.

plugins.name: improve
plugins.description: Generic self-improvement implementer using the autoresearch ML methodology. Reads the app's IMPROVEMENT_PROGRAM.md, fetches proposals from GitHub Issues (label 'autoresearch'), implements changes.

plugins.name: intent-guard
plugins.description: EXPERIMENTAL — Guarda de intenção: caderno append-only dos pedidos verbatim do usuário + gates de plano, checkpoint e ENTREGA (auditoria independente por subagente de contexto virgem, prompt canônico, veredito CONFIRMADO/INFERIDO com evidência). v0.4.0: auditoria dispara no COMMIT (não a cada turno) e ganha escada de custo — pedido com receita mecânica (ex.: 'commit push' → compara hashes) é resolvido por CÓDIGO, sem agente; numa sessão real 4 de 7 pedidos eram isso, ~50k tokens cada. O juiz só ESCOLHE de um catálogo fechado, nunca escreve comando. v0.3.0: pedidos escopados por sessão (sessões paralelas dividiam a lista de vivos). v0.2.0: tree-hash ignora artefato de execução; juízes internos não poluem o caderno. Baixa automática é experimental. Kill-switch: ~/.claude/intent-guard/mode=off.

plugins.name: principles
plugins.description: Contextual system design principles for planning and review. Reads PRINCIPIOS-SISTEMAS.md, maps relevant categories to the current context, generates a practical guide with WHY + HOW.

plugins.name: project-doc
plugins.description: Generate a modular documentation system from ALL project evidence — the invocation discourse, files, handoffs, memory, graph, git log, and session transcripts — kept in a versioned append-only journal, projected into a lightweight CLAUDE.md routing table + .claude/docs/*.md per concern + thin pointers (AGENTS.md, GEMINI.md, .cursorrules). FOUR skills: /project-doc (mines everything), /doc-touch (incremental), /start-doc (interviews the human for the authorial docs no mining can produce — quality goals, constraints, context, strategy, glossary, and design.md for projects with a UI — and never invents them), and /design-md (absorbed from the standalone design-md plugin: writes/validates/exports Google's DESIGN.md format via the official CLI). v3.17.0: the doc-touch stamp is now a verb (--restamp) that writes generated, generated-commit and doc-sig in one go, preserving the DOC-SET gen instead of the code's — a doc cannot cite the commit that contains it, so the ritual is two commits and the tool now owns it. v3.16.0: the staleness measure the HOOKS consume (project_staleness) now honors generated-commit instead of a day-granularity date window, and matches scope entries with _scope_match instead of raw string intersection — a /doc-touch followed by a same-day commit no longer reports freshly generated docs as stale, and a doc scoped by directory can finally go stale. v3.15.0: design.md becomes the 6th authorial doc, gated to projects with a detected frontend (lib-has-frontend.sh); sessionstart-doc.sh now also nudges when a mined project has zero authorial docs (not just when there's no doc at all). Gen 3.8 adds the data-asset axis (data-stores.md + durability.md: every store enumerated, every store's backup declared or explicitly justified), runtime.md end-to-end scenarios, verified-by provenance in frontmatter, and a project-root ADR log. A plan gate hook blocks planning in an undocumented project until /start-doc runs, with a verbal escape. Scrubber moves secrets to a vault, never to git. Supports delta/--deep/--rebuild, monorepo layouts, artifact cleanup, and ORGANISM support (de-silo) with an inverted blast-radius gate.

plugins.name: qa-loop
plugins.description: Review→fix loop that stops at diminishing returns, not at zero. Runs as a deterministic Workflow (Opus reviews → Opus plans/adjudicates → fixes; gate, churn and stop condition live in code). Anchored to the plan in 3 buckets — implementation / plan-drift / broken-plan — and to the project's own quality goals, read from .claude/docs/quality-goals.md at review time rather than copied into the skill. Regression gate per fix, accepted-limits, a human HTML report plus an agent-facing journal. Replaces qa, rev6 and iterate.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Production deploy flow: lint, type-check, commit, push, deploy in one disciplined sequence.

plugins.name: slides
plugins.description: Markdown → keynote-grade single-file HTML deck. Two modes: (A) transcription — renders a ready .md faithfully, never invents text; (B) explainer — drives the didactics (narrative structure, audience level, granular vs summary, infographics) to teach a concept, grounded (factual + current). Theme system (VIU default), no-JS adaptive (WhatsApp thumbnail).

plugins.name: sovai
plugins.description: Autonomous run mode — executes a plan end to end with no pauses, checkpoints or confirmations. Skips blockers without silent workarounds, records every decision, runs a headless qa-loop pass and delivers a structured report. The engine is a deterministic Workflow (decompose → execute → review) and a PreToolUse hook enforces it: while the mission is armed every sub-agent spawn is denied. The reviewer judges the work against the SPEC, not against the orchestrator's own decomposition — reviewing against your own breakdown is a closed circuit where a wrong breakdown gets approved. Five axes: spec · the project's own quality goals · traceability (every task carries its requirement and its definition of done) · completeness · cohesion. A dead agent degrades the mission instead of killing the engine.

plugins.name: visual
plugins.description: CLI walls-of-text → interactive HTML dark-theme views. The page carries the EVIDENCE, not the account of it: real artifact embedded, raw output verbatim, provenance for every number — enforced by a pre-ExitPlanMode gate. Prose is REFUSED by the builder: every text field is checked (≤140 chars per bullet, one sentence each, no continuation connective, max 6 per block) and a violation aborts without writing the page. Each problem's body is born folded — the title stays visible, consequence and proposal open on click under a label derived from the content itself. Plans, diagnostics and decisions in the browser with live sync back to Claude.
